Styleguide.title: Styleguide
Styleguide.intro: Shared building blocks for every page. All data on this page is sample data.
Styleguide.colorsHint: Every text/background pair is checked against WCAG AA contrast in a test.
Styleguide.bodySample: Nguyễn Văn Ánh checks the total and the VAT of the invoice.
Styleguide.fieldSellerHint: Exactly as printed on the invoice.
Styleguide.fieldTaxCodeError: Invalid tax code: wrong check digit.
Styleguide.fieldTotalWarning: Low confidence, compare with the source document.
Styleguide.emptyHint: Upload your first invoice to get started.
Styleguide.errorHint: Check your connection and try again.
Styleguide.a11y1: Text meets 4.5:1 contrast; borders and focus rings meet 3:1.
Styleguide.a11y2: Every input has a label tied by htmlFor.
Styleguide.a11y3: Keyboard: Tab reaches every control and the focus ring is always visible.
Styleguide.a11y4: Status always has a word and an icon, never colour alone.
Styleguide.a11y5: Errors use role=alert; loading uses role=status.

failure.unknown: The document could not be processed. The code below tells an administrator why.
failure.EXTRACTION_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED: The extraction service did not answer after several attempts. Try again later or ask an administrator to retry.
failure.EXTRACTION_STALLED: Processing was interrupted too many times.
failure.EXTRACTION_FAILED: The document could not be processed.
failure.EXTRACTION_SCHEMA_INVALID: The extraction service returned data that is not a valid invoice.
failure.EXTRACTION_PATH_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The extraction service does not support this file type.
failure.FILE_MISSING: The stored file could not be found.
failure.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large to process.
failure.XML_MALFORMED: The file is not well-formed XML.
failure.XML_TOO_COMPLEX: The XML is too deeply nested or too large to process safely.
failure.XML_UNSUPPORTED_STRUCTURE: This XML is not an invoice structure the system supports.
failure.XML_MISSING_FIELD: The invoice XML is missing a required field.
failure.XML_INVALID_VALUE: The invoice XML has a value that is not valid.
failure.XML_UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY: The invoice currency is not supported.
failure.XML_UNSUPPORTED_VAT_RATE: The invoice uses a VAT rate that is not supported.
failure.AI_SERVICE_MISCONFIGURED: The extraction service is not set up correctly (for example a wrong access token). This is not a problem with your file; ask an administrator to fix it and retry.
failure.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service was overloaded or unavailable after several attempts. Try again later or ask an administrator to retry.
failure.LLM_RATE_LIMITED: The AI service is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes or ask an administrator to retry.
failure.LLM_TIMEOUT_OR_NETWORK: The AI service did not answer in time after several attempts. Try again later or ask an administrator to retry.
failure.LLM_BAD_RESPONSE: The AI service sent an unreadable response after several attempts. Ask an administrator to retry.
failure.LLM_MISCONFIGURED: The connection to the AI service is not set up correctly (for example a wrong key or model name). This is not a problem with your file; ask an administrator to fix it and retry.
failure.LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED: The AI service is not set up to read PDFs and images. Ask an administrator to configure it, or upload an XML invoice.
failure.LLM_REQUEST_REJECTED: The AI service refused to process this file. Try another file.
failure.LLM_NO_CANDIDATE: The AI service gave no result for this file. Try another file.
failure.PDF_INVALID: The file is not a readable PDF.
failure.PDF_TOO_MANY_PAGES: The PDF has too many pages to process.
failure.PDF_TOO_LARGE: The PDF's pages are too large to process. Reduce the page size or resolution.
failure.IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED: The image format is not supported. Use PNG or JPEG.
failure.XML_FORBIDDEN_CONSTRUCT: The XML contains a DTD or entity declaration, which is not allowed.

Review.warningsTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No warnings} one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
Review.noWarnings: The numbers, dates and tax codes pass every check.
Review.legend: Yellow fields with a triangle need a look: the AI rated its own confidence below {percent}%, or a check failed. Hover a field to see why. Dashed fields: the AI gave no confidence. An unmarked field is not a verified one, because the confidence is the AI's own rating: compare with the original. Nothing is ever changed for you.

reason.noMetaNote: Dashed fields: the AI gave no confidence.
